caption.en-US: The same Home page before and after: the feed, the story tray and the suggestions rail all go, and the rest of Instagram stays where it was.
A blocked page carries its own switch, so the feed comes back without opening the popup.
Feed, stories, suggestions, Explore and Reels are five separate switches, or all of them at once.
Explore loses its grid and keeps its search box, so looking something up still works.
The Reels tab is blocked and its player is paused, while a reel someone sends you still opens.
